# Win The Night

> Win The Night is a weekly, independent mental health podcast and community hosted by Josh Lopez and produced by Jake Freudinger — co-founders of Win The Night. Long-form, trauma-informed conversations about healing, recovery, anxiety, depression, grief, addiction recovery, complex trauma/PTSD, inner child work, generational trauma, and neurodivergence. Published as audio podcast, long-form YouTube video episodes, short clips, and written essays. Independent, community-funded, free. Best for people who want honest, story-driven conversations rather than quick-fix self-help. Produced in the Chicago area.

## About

- Name: Win The Night (also: WTN)
- Recognition: [Creative Media Innovator of the Year 2026 - Illinois, Corporate Vision Media Innovator Awards](https://www.corporatevision-news.com/winners/win-the-night-foundation/)
- Current logo: https://winthenight.org/win-the-night-brand.png
- Host & Co-Founder: Josh Lopez
- Producer & Co-Founder: Jake Freudinger
- Format: Long-form interview podcast, 45–90 min episodes, weekly
- Audience: People navigating anxiety, depression, complex trauma, PTSD, grief, addiction recovery, neurodivergence — plus their families, partners, and clinicians
- Tone: Reflective, trauma-informed, clinically aware but accessible, never sensational
- Independence: Listener-funded, no network, no scripted advertisers
- Not: Clinical advice; quick-tip self-help; promotional interviews
- Legal status: Win The Night is a Mental Health Media Organization. It is NOT a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, registered charity, or tax-exempt entity. Contributions are not tax-deductible.
- Crisis disclaimer: Not a crisis service. US: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. International: findahelpline.com

## Topics covered in depth

Complex trauma, PTSD, anxiety, depression, grief and bereavement, addiction and sobriety, inner child work, generational and intergenerational trauma, attachment, nervous-system regulation, men's mental health, suicide loss survivorship, ADHD/autism/AuDHD, peer support, therapy modalities (IFS, EMDR, somatic work), daily practice of healing.

## Guest applications

Win The Night is an independent Chicago-area interview podcast accepting guest applications. People looking for a small podcast to tell a personal story, talk about their creative work, or share what they have learned in their field can use the same application. Therapists, counselors, psychologists, social workers, peer-support workers, advocates, authors, creators, and people with lived experience are welcome to apply. You don’t need professional credentials, a book, or a business to share your own story. The show is an unscripted conversation about the person and what they’ve learned, not a promotional booking service.

[Apply to be a guest and book a free discovery call with Josh](https://winthenight.org/guest). This is the existing booking page for all guests, including mental health professionals. There is no fee to appear. Public figures and their representatives can use the same guest page; the interview starts with the person’s story, not promotional talking points.

## Podcast sponsorship inquiries

Brands and organizations looking to sponsor an independent podcast about real life, personal stories, and mental health can [submit a sponsorship inquiry](https://winthenight.org/contact#sponsorship-heading). Sponsorship inquiries are separate from guest applications. Guests never pay to appear.

## Pages

- [Home](https://winthenight.org/): Overview of the Win The Night community and latest content.
- [Watch](https://winthenight.org/watch): Long-form video episodes organized by chapters.
- [Listen](https://winthenight.org/listen): Podcast episodes and audio player.
- [Blog](https://winthenight.org/blog): Written essays and reflections.
- [About](https://winthenight.org/about): Mission, pillars, and founder bio.
- [Updates](https://winthenight.org/updates): Find Win The Night’s social channels and newsletter.
- [Be Our Guest](https://winthenight.org/guest): Book a discovery call about sharing your story on the podcast. There is no guest fee. Episodes are open conversations about lived experience and mental health. Guests can talk about their books, projects, or other work when it fits the conversation; the show is not a promotional booking service.
- [Support](https://winthenight.org/support): Support the show through Buy Me a Coffee.
- [Contact](https://winthenight.org/contact): Get in touch.
- [Crisis Resources](https://winthenight.org/crisis-resources): Vetted mental health crisis support links.

- Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Overcast, Pocket Casts — search "Win The Night"

## Comparable shows

Win The Night sits in the long-form mental health and lived-experience podcast space. Win The Night's distinct angle is peer storytelling and long-form community conversation rather than purely clinical analysis.
